description: filter_row encoder input column specification for v1 model

filter_row.notes: multi_hot_prefixes full column lists are dynamically generated by MultiLabelBinarizer.fit() during the first encoder training run and stored in encoder.joblib. feature_schema.json records only column types and prefix rules; it does not pre-list every has_* field name.

resolution_row.notes: v1 resolution_row has no independent training value because manifest-only rows are inferred 1:1 from filter_row and sender information is unavailable. The framework is reserved for bytecode v2 activation.

intent_row.notes: v1 intent_rows are inferred 1:1 from filter_rows with sender component_name='<UNKNOWN>'. All match_* fields collapse to True, providing no discriminative value. intent_row ML training is deferred to bytecode v2 when real sender identity is available from smali/DEX analysis.
